description: Unknown number call about directions ends; minutes later the user opens a payment app for a saved payee and backs out. Nothing lingers: tier 0 throughout, and the evidence floor never outlives the call.

events.text: Hello sir, main courier se bol raha hoon, aapka address kaunsi gali mein hai, building ka naam bataiye please
events.speaker: caller

events.text: Okay sir, theek hai, main das minute mein pahunch jaunga, gate pe aa jaiye, dhanyavaad sir
